products.name: Sierra
products.note: Conversational AI for customer experience; enterprise agent platform

profile_text.body:
Sierra is a San Francisco-based company founded in 2023 that builds AI-powered tools for customer experience. According to its website, the company helps businesses create what it describes as better, more human customer experiences with AI, positioning its offering as something beyond simple automation and oriented toward interactions that feel personal and thoughtful.

The company's primary product, also called Sierra, is categorized as a conversational AI and enterprise agent platform. It is designed to let businesses deploy AI agents that handle customer interactions at scale while, in the company's framing, preserving a sense of care and responsiveness in those exchanges.

The held facts show Sierra has a notable legal footprint, with 174 cases recorded in California, though no specific litigation details are included in the available data. The company has no MCP server presence on record and no SEC or patent filings noted at this time.
